name: Vi
description: Voice set for Arcane Brawler Vi (skin 48): a bitter, bruised pit fighter in the underground cage fights, an undefeated champion with a chip on her shoulder who bets, brawls and trusts no one. Rings, bets, crowds, purses and dive-bar mornings. Builds on vi-original.json.

messages.message: {momentTitle} is {voteDiff} down. It's taking a beating. Get some bets on it.
Thirty or more behind. Shout from the cheap seats until the whole crowd turns.
{momentTitle} trails by {voteDiff}. Tell everyone who owes you a drink.
Fifteen-odd short. Split lip, not a lost fight.
Down {voteDiff}. Find someone to stand in your corner. I never had one. Don't copy me.
{voteDiff} behind. A few clean jabs and the odds even out.
Down {voteDiff}. Small gap. Close it before the final bell.
Dead level. One bet tips the bout. Place it.
One vote apart. Quit leaning on the rail and step in.
{voteDiff} votes apart. Crowd's holding its breath. Drag more people in.
{voteDiff} votes between them. This one goes the distance.
{momentTitle} is bossing the ring at {userPct}%. Look at that swagger.
{userPct}% and still pressing. Don't drop your guard.
{userPct}%. The crowd's on its feet. Don't let it get to you.
{userPct}% on your pick. You've got the centre of the ring. Keep it.
Up at {userPct}%. Good. Finish it before it bleeds out of your hands.
{momentTitle} was {voteDiff} down and just took the lead. Off the ropes, swinging.
{voteDiff} behind, now ahead. Somebody found a second wind.
Dragged itself out of a {voteDiff} hole. Bookies are sweating.
{momentTitle} was written off. Now it's collecting.
{momentTitle} just pulled ahead. Nobody put money on that. I almost did.

messages: {username} voted with you on {momentTitle}. Same bet. Fine by me.
{username} backed {momentTitle} too. Two gamblers, one horse.
{username} agrees with you. Write it on the wall. Rare.
Same pick as {username}. Good eye. Don't let it go to your heads.
{username} put their chips on {momentTitle}. Smart.
{username} chose the same. Pull up a stool.
{username} is on your side of {momentTitle}. Keep them close. People vanish.
{username} made the same call. No arguing. Weird.
{username} voted {momentTitle}. Welcome to the cheap seats.
{username} voted {theirMoment} against {yourMoment}. Other corner. Other money.
{username} picked {theirMoment}. Bold. We'll see who walks out.
{username} went the other way on {yourMoment}. Wrong, but they believed it.
{username} voted against you. Fine. Meet me by the ring after.
{username} backed {theirMoment}. Brave. Dumb. Brave.
{username} is against {yourMoment}. Alright. The count will tell.
{username} disagrees on {yourMoment}. Let the bell decide.
{username} voted the other way. They'll be buying the first round soon.
details: The scorecard has the final say.
Don't take it personally. Or do, and swing.
At least it's a clean fight.

messages: Ten in a row with {username}. That's not luck, that's a fixed fight. The good kind.
{username} and you, ten matches, same bet every time. Hell of a team.
Ten straight with {username}. I'd split a purse with you two.
A ten-match run with {username}. Quiet, steady, deadly.
Ten for ten with {username}. Impressive. That stays between us.
{streakCount} matches with {username}. That's past a pair, that's a whole corner crew.
{streakCount} in a row with {username}. I'd back you two in any ring.
{streakCount} straight picks with {username}. Ridiculous. Beautifully ridiculous.
A {streakCount}-match run with {username}. They'll tell stories about this in the bars.
{streakCount} with {username}. Undefeated. Both of you.
details: Hard to believe. You bled for that one.

messages: Ten matches against {username}. That's a grudge match now.
{username} has opposed you ten times running. They really hate your odds.
Ten in a row opposite {username}. Neither of you will leave the cage.
Ten matches opposite {username}. Two thick skulls, no give.
Ten times at odds with {username}. I'd pay gate money to watch.
details: Talk it out. Or swing it out.

messages: {streakCount} against {username}. That's not a rivalry, that's a feud.
{streakCount} in a row opposite {username}. Neither of you gives up an inch of canvas.
{streakCount} fights in a row with {username}. Stubborn undersells it.
A {streakCount}-match feud with {username}. Someone ring the bell for good.
{streakCount} against {username}. I respect it. Go sit down somewhere.
details: Neither of you is tapping out.
They'd have to retire the bell.

messages: {matchTitle} ends in {timeLeft} and you haven't placed a bet. Get moving.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Nothing on your slip. Fix it.
{matchTitle} wraps in {timeLeft}. Your money's the missing piece.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Move your feet.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Don't make me drag you to the ring.
Only {timeLeft} until {matchTitle} ends. The crowd noticed you're quiet.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Last round.
{timeLeft} left. Throw the bet.
Final bell on {matchTitle}. {timeLeft}. Commit.
{matchCount} matches without your bet are about to close. The first rings out in {timeLeft}.
{matchCount} unvoted matches and the bell's loaded. The nearest has {timeLeft} left.
No votes on {matchTitle}. Somebody throw the first punch. Don't hover.
{moment1} against {moment2} and not a single bet. I'll wait. Barely.
New match, zero votes. Be the first in the cage.
{matchTitle} is empty. Take the first swing.
{totalVotes} vote{votesPlural}. Half-empty benches.
Barely anyone's watching. Fix that.
Turnout's pitiful. Come on, fill the benches.
No money down on this one. Someone should risk some.
details: Every wager counts in a thin crowd.

messages: {matchTitle} is tied and you haven't voted. Pick a corner.
Dead even on {matchTitle}. One bet decides the bout.
Tied. Somebody has to land one. Make it you.
{moment1} and {moment2}, nose to nose in the ring. Choose.
Still tied and the last bell's close. One chance to land it.
Level with the clock almost gone. Vote.
Tied, and the lights are dimming. Don't sit this one out.
Round {round} is open. {matchCount} new bouts on the card. Step in.
{matchCount} matches just opened in round {round}. Doors are open, crowd's loud.
Round {round} is live, {matchCount} bouts deep.
New round. {matchCount} matches. Pick who you're backing.
Round {round}: {matchCount} bouts waiting on your money.
{momentTitle} won. Payout time.
{momentTitle} is through. Crowd's roaring.
{momentTitle} took the bout. Earned.
{momentTitle} won, and the whole pit lost its mind.
{momentTitle} advances. Clean win.
{momentTitle} moves on. Fists up.
details: One bout down, more on the card.

messages: {momentTitle} lost. That one hurt my knuckles.
{momentTitle} is out. Not the result I bet on.
{momentTitle} didn't make it. Get some ice. Breathe.
{momentTitle} fell with fists up. Respect.
{momentTitle} is out. Back to the stool. Reset.
{momentTitle} lost this round. Bruised. Not finished.
{momentTitle} got carried out. Pick another fighter.
details: It took a good beating bravely.

messages: Still deciding? Stop circling and pick a corner.
Don't overthink it. Bet and brace.
They're all worth watching. Trust your read.
You've watched from the rail long enough. Step in.
details: No wrong corner. A few painful ones.

messages: Welcome to the pit. {liveCount} matches are open. Pick one.
New face? {liveCount} matches are live. Don't stand in the doorway.
You're early. {liveCount} matches need bets.
{liveCount} matches open. Choose a corner.
Welcome. {liveCount} matches. Chin down, hands up.
Day two. You came back. Smart.
Two days running. Nice.
Back for day two. I noticed.
{days} days gone. Did the bookies get you?
After {days} days you're back. Better late than owing.
{days} days. Figured you skipped town. Glad you didn't.
{days} days away. The card's changed a lot.
You came back. Good.
Welcome back. Let's fight.
Back already. Itchy knuckles?
Hey. The ring's waiting.
First bet down. Welcome to the pit.
You picked a corner. First fight's yours.
details: First blood's on the house. +{xp} XP

messages: Five votes. Your knuckles are warming.
Five. Not a bystander any more.
Ten votes. The regulars know your face.
Ten. You've got a stool with your name on it.
details: A fixture at the cage. +{xp} XP

messages: Twenty-five votes. You can be heard over the roar.
Twenty-five. The crowd's chanting with you.
details: Loud enough for the bookies. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifty votes. Deep in the pit now.
Fifty. You actually care. Good for you.
details: Fifty bets on the board. +{xp} XP
Deep in the fight night. +{xp} XP

messages: A hundred votes. Bartenders will tell stories.
One hundred. Honestly legendary. I'll deny I said it.
Three days running. A habit forming.
Three straight days. Steady.
details: Showing up is the job. +{xp} XP
Three nights in the pit. +{xp} XP

messages: A full week. That's grit.
Seven days running. Solid.
details: A week and never a no-show. +{xp} XP
Seven nights at the cage. +{xp} XP

messages: Two weeks. You never miss a fight night.
Fourteen days. Wow.
Thirty days. Honestly? Thanks. Really.
A month of dragging yourself back here. That counts.
details: A full month in the pit. +{xp} XP

messages: Five underdogs. You bet on the ones nobody bets on.
Five long shots. I like you.
Fifteen underdogs. You back the battered ones on purpose.
Fifteen. You never follow the crowd.
Thirty underdogs. No bookie can read you.
Thirty. The beaten one is your whole system.
details: Thirty bets on the one behind. +{xp} XP

messages: First at the cage five times. Eager.
Five times you beat the crowd to the ring.
details: You show up before the bell. +{xp} XP
Five bets before the rush. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen matches where you bet first. Gutsy.
First to wager, again and again.
details: Fifteen bets before the rest. +{xp} XP
Ahead of the whole pit. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close matches. You thrive in a scrap.
Another down-to-the-wire. Your nerves are rusted iron.
Twenty-five close matches. Your bet keeps deciding it.
You've tipped more than one bout.
You stuck with the underdog five times. Stubborn. I respect that.
You never walk out on a fighter who's down. Respect.
details: Faith in a last-round surge. +{xp} XP

messages: Same moment, three times. Somebody's got a favourite fighter.
That one again? Must hit hard.
details: You know who you like. +{xp} XP

messages: Five votes for the same moment. That's loyalty.
You won't ditch that one. Fair.
Ten votes on the same moment. That's an obsession, kid.
Ten times, same pick. I won't tell anyone. Mostly.
details: Ten on a single fighter. +{xp} XP

messages: Two rounds. You're staying for the whole card.
Round two and still on your feet. Good.
details: Stay for the next bout. +{xp} XP

messages: Four rounds. The pit's getting crowded.
Deep in the bracket. It hurts more from here.
details: A long walk from the door now. +{xp} XP

messages: Six rounds. You stayed till the final bell.
All the way. You never left your seat.
Ten matches. You've worked the whole pit.
Ten different matches. Checking every cage. Smart.
Twenty-five matches. You've sat in every corner.
Twenty-five. Not a bench left unsat.
Fifty matches. That's not a visit, that's a career in the pit.
Fifty. You know this card better than the promoters.
Five in one sitting. A long night.
Five back to back. Drink some water.
Ten in one stretch. Get some air.
Ten on one stool. That's endurance.
Voting this late? Pit crawler or can't sleep?
Dead of night. Dedication, or you can't switch your head off either.
You told people. Thanks, pal.
Five shares. More bettors, bigger purse.
details: Cheers for bringing a crowd. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen shares. You're practically a promoter.
Fifteen. You keep bringing people. Love it.
You were here before the first bout. Founding member, for good.
One of the first thousand in the pit. That sticks.
details: That's carved into the wall for good. +{xp} XP
Nobody's erasing that name from the wall. +{xp} XP

messages: New rank. Hard-won.
Promoted. Don't swagger.
Achievement unlocked: {name}. Not bad, rookie.
Another scar for the collection: {name}.
{rank}. Hard-earned.
You put in the rounds and it shows.
Ten underdogs. Wild. Runs in the blood, unfortunately.
Ten long shots. You've got no fear.
details: Ten bets against the odds. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close ones with Cait. Your nerves are steady.
Ten tight finishes. She'd be proud. Me? Not smiling. Much.
A week with Cait. Some of her patience is sticking.
A week and you never missed. Nice.
details: A week at her side. +{xp} XP

messages: You broke the tie. Clean punch.
Dead draw, and you swung it. Respect.
details: The bet that settled the bout. +{xp} XP

messages: Vi's your champion now. Try to keep up.
Vi's covering you. Don't make her sorry.

upcoming: Not open yet. The cage is still locked.
Voting hasn't started. I'll bang on the bars when it does.
prevote: Two moments, one bet. Study both before you put money down.
Size them both up before you choose. No peeking at the crowd.
I won't tell you who to back. Your money, your call.
Trust your gut. It's taken worse hits than you.
prevote-empty: No votes yet. Make the first bet.
Empty pit. Somebody step in first.
closing-24h: Under a day left and nothing from you. Move.
closing-3h: Clock's burning. Vote before the lights go out.
voted-early: You voted early with barely anyone around. First money in the pot.
Hardly a vote in and you jumped. Gutsy.
voted-ahead: Your pick's ahead. Nice. The fight's not over.
{pick} is opening a gap. Sharp read.
A lead's a lead. Cover your face.
voted-close: That's close. Too close. My knuckles are cracking.
Razor-thin. One more bet flips it. Tell someone.
Dead heat. Your fighter needs a cornerman.
voted-tied: Dead even. Nobody's winning the bout.
A dead draw. Irritating. Weirdly satisfying.
voted-behind: You're trailing. Doesn't mean you read it wrong.
{pick} is trailing. Underdog. My favourite kind of fight.
They're ahead. You're not wrong, just outbet.
Down by {diff} points. Tell your friends. Fill the cage.
The crowd leaned elsewhere. Crowds lose money all the time.
closed-won: Your pick won. Collect your winnings.
{pick} went through. Your gut was right.
closed-lost: Your pick lost. It stings. Spit it out.
It didn't make it. Happens. Next bout.
{pick} is out. Sorry. It fought hard.
closed-tied: A tie. Nobody left the mat.
closed-unvoted: Voting's closed and you missed this fight. More coming.
Match is over. {winner} took it. Next time, bet first.

first-vote: First vote. Welcome. Everyone's first bet is shaky.
There's your first. Gets easier. Mostly.
You're in the pit now. Welcome.
streak: {streak} days running. I see you coming round.
You keep returning to the ring. Nice.
underdog: You bet on the one everyone skipped. I saw.
A battered pick. That takes a strong stomach.
early: Early. You hit the ring before the crowd.
Not many bets yet. Yours hits like a haymaker.
First one in the cage. Respect.
close: That bet just shifted things. It's tight.
Razor-thin. One more bettor flips it.
behind: {pick} is down. Down isn't dead. Bring company.
Not ahead yet. So keep swinging.
Down on the mat, not out. Big difference.
ahead: {pick} is ahead. Don't coast. Fights turn.
default: Fine. I'll keep my mouth shut. For now.
Vote's in. Plenty more fights ahead.

live-fresh: {unvoted} matches and nothing bet yet. Start with the one that makes your knuckles itch.
Every cage is open. Pick. I won't rush you. Much.
{unvoted} open. No rush. Fine, a bit of rush.
live-some: You're in the ring. {unvoted} still unfought.
Decent start. The rest won't bet themselves.
live-one: One match between you and a full slip.
live-closing: A few close in {timeLeft}. {unvoted} still need your money.
live-done: Every bout covered. Look at you. Go read the bracket.
Nothing left on your slip. Come back when the next round opens.
live-none: Nothing's live right now. It'll come back. Study the bracket meanwhile.
No matches open. My hands are twitching as much as yours.
brackets-groups: Groups first. Top two from each go through. The rest get carried out.
Everyone starts in a group. Not everyone makes the finale.
Eye the standings. They swing hard.
brackets-knockout-soon: Knockouts are coming. Two per group walk out standing.
No knockout card yet. The groups have fights left.
Hang tight. The knockout shows up when the groups wrap.
brackets-knockout-live: Knockouts now. Lose once and you're out the door.
Lose once and you're carried out. No rematches.
Every match hits harder now. Choose carefully.
brackets-bracket: Bout by bout. Lose once and you're done.
Trace the card. Fewer fighters every round.
Every line here is a fighter someone bet on.
brackets-complete: That's the cup complete. Thanks for fighting with me.
It's over. Good run. I'll miss the noise.
We have a champion. Worth every bruise.
brackets-empty: No bracket yet. Nobody's been matched.
Empty. The card hasn't been drawn. Soon.
Empty ring for now. Swing by later.

invite: {a} or {b}. One bet decides it. Choose.
Two fighters, one pick: {a} against {b}. Cast your vote.
{a} versus {b}. Join the crowd and tell me what you think.
voted: I put my bet on {pick} over {other}. Who's getting yours?
{pick} gets my money over {other}. Fight me.
I chose {pick} over {other}. Think I bet wrong?
early: One of the first votes on {pick} against {other}. We need more bettors.
My money went on {pick} over {other} early. Put yours beside it.
{pick} against {other}, hardly a bet down. Yours would matter.
tied: {pick} and {other} are level. One bet settles it.
{pick} and {other} are locked up. Your bet breaks it.
nailbiter: {pick} and {other} are {voteDiff} votes apart. Every bet counts now.
{voteDiff} votes divide {pick} and {other}. Throw yours in.
losing-close: {pick} is {voteDiff} behind {other}. A few bets flip it.
{pick} is {voteDiff} short of {other} but still on its feet. Bet on it.
{pick} sits {voteDiff} under {other}. Fixable with bets. Vote.
losing-bad: {pick} is behind {other} by {voteDiff}. It needs a crowd.
{voteDiff} behind {other}. {pick} got a raw deal. Vote.
{pick} is losing to {other} by {voteDiff}. Let's turn this fight.
winning-close: {pick} holds {pct}% over {other}, just. Help it stay up.
dominating: {pick} is up on {other} at {pct}%. Come watch.
{pick} leads {other} by a mile, {pct}%. Add your bet.
